chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Nuʿmān al-Aḥwal asked him about a man who advanced the zakat of his wealth, then the recipient became wealthy before the end of the year. He said:
"The giver must pay the zakat again."

key_terms.الْمُعْطَى: the one to whom it was given, the recipient
key_terms.الْمُعْطِي: the giver, the one who paid the zakat
key_terms.رَأْسِ السَّنَةِ: the completion or turning point of the year
key_terms.زَكَاةَ: zakat, the obligatory alms due on wealth
key_terms.مَالِهِ: his wealth, the property from which zakat is paid

ai.seo_question: If someone gives zakat early and the recipient becomes wealthy before the year ends, must the zakat be paid again?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning zakat paid in advance. If the person who received it ceases to qualify before the completion of the year by becoming affluent, the giver must pay the zakat again.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1615 - Muhammad ibn al-Nu'man al-Ahwal asked him (Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)) about a man who advanced the Zakat of his wealth, but the recipient became wealthy before the year's end.
Imam (as) replied: "The giver must pay the Zakat again."
